comment: Recall gate query set for the nOS self-model. GENERATED by tools/keap-recall-queries.py from the '**Trigger:**' lines in docs/systems/<svc>/SKILLS.md — do not hand-edit; edit the SKILLS.md and regenerate. Each case asserts MEANING, not length: the named skill card and the system node that owns it must win the query. 'node:<id>' names a taxonomy node; 'title:<t>' names a card by title (fs-sync ids are content-addressed, titles are the stable handle). The forbid lists encode the _stack.md failure class: a stack node or the root must never beat the specific system or skill its query names. Where two systems advertise the same trigger phrase the cases are merged, so expect may name more than one winner.
